title: Say You'll Remember Me (Say You'll Remember Me, #1)
author: Abby Jimenez

facts.text: It debuted at #1 on the New York Times Best Seller list in both Hardcover Fiction and Combined Print & E-Book Fiction after its April 1, 2025 release from Forever.
The romance starts at a vet clinic: Xavier Rush is the veterinarian, and Samantha Diaz meets him when she brings in her kitten. The catch is that she's about to move 2,000 miles away.
It's book 1 of a series. Book 2 follows Xavier's friend Chris, and a third book about his friend Mike is set for 2027.
Abby Jimenez has sold over 1.5 million copies of her novels, translated into 28 languages.
